findings.text: The company's status is 'active', with the detail recorded as active-proposal-to-strike-off.
The company was incorporated on 2 September 2015, making it 11.1 years old.
The accounts are overdue; they were last made up to 30 September 2021 and the next accounts were due 30 June 2023.
The confirmation statement is overdue; it was last made up to 1 September 2021 and the next one was due 15 September 2022.
There are 2 current officers, both directors: PERSON 334 (appointed 11 April 2022) and PERSON 335 (appointed 2 September 2015).
One current person with significant control is recorded: PERSON 338, an individual holding 25 to 50 percent of the shares.
No charges are registered against the company, and Companies House holds no insolvency record for it.
Across the 2 current directors, 2 other companies were found (1 active, 1 dissolved), though this may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
No registered office address changes and no officer appointments or resignations have been filed since 24 October 2025.

headline.text: TEST COMPANY 456 is active but has a proposal to be struck off the register, with its accounts and confirmation statement both overdue.
